title: Your options screener is a metal detector on a beach full of bottle caps
author: OptionScout
selftext:
Static filters (min volume / OI / DTE) dump hundreds of hits. Most of them are rolls, hedges, or one leg of a spread.

What actually cleaned up signal for me:  
1. **Delta-adjusted volume** — 1k deep OTM calls ≠ 1k ATM calls in conviction  
2. **Sweep detection** — urgency + how far above mid they paid  
3. **Multi-leg reconstruction** — don’t call the long call of a call vertical “bullish flow”  
4. **Expiration segmentation** — 0DTE traders and swing traders should not see the same firehose  
5. **GEX overlay** — same sweep into short vs long dealer gamma is opposite EV

Also: paper the alerts 2–3 weeks. Track expectancy, not just win rate. Ignore “accuracy %” marketing that doesn’t show losers or exit rules.

Wrote this up as scanner vs traditional screener + filter table:  
https://optionscout.ai/blog/ai-options-scanner

(Disclosure: OptionScout blog — we build a scanner/flow/GEX stack. Salt accordingly.)
